svg.text: Base weldment (seat ring, upstand, skirt, centring tabs)
Body weldment (shell, top flange, magnet bars, screen ledge, isolator brackets, vibrator bra…
Lid weldment (disc, 4 in inlet + 3 in dust ferrules, 3 hold-down pads, keeper tabs)
Screen deck 12 mesh (upper + lower ring, cloth)
Hold-down pad cap, FDA silicone Ø30 x 8
Rubber mount M8 Ø30 x 30 40 Sh
rests by weight; 3 tabs centre it ±2
liner folded over the rim under the seat
hose to P1-310, blast gate ≈ 100 cfm
body to base braid P1-347; base to drum ground clip
1. Vibrating parts: body 200, lid 300, deck 400, magnet, vibrator. Fixed: base 100 on the drum.
2. Vibrator weights set to about 78 % for ±0.3 mm at the deck (4.3 g); see P1-304-900.
3. Isolators give 11.2 Hz on 60 N/mm each: 3.6 % of the force reaches the drum.
4. Lift-off: drum rolls out on its dolly with the sifter removed (2 people, ≈ 45 kg [100 lb] with base).
